content:
- Model consistently overestimates prices in the early part of the forecast horizon, especially after recent spikes.
- Underestimates prices in the latter half of the forecast, particularly when true values show upward momentum or mean reversion.
- Tends to overshoot after sharp price spikes, then corrects too slowly — lagging the true decline or rise.
- Overconfident in short-term momentum; fails to account for mean reversion in 30-day windows.
- Underestimates downward trends in the final 5–10 days of the forecast, especially when true values show a sharp drop.
- Overestimates volatility in the middle of the forecast, leading to over-optimistic peaks.
- Model exhibits bias toward higher values when recent history shows strong upward momentum, and underestimates when momentum is weak or reversing.
